captions.detailed: A simple, solid-looking 3D sphere with a moderately faceted surface. The model is rendered as a uniform gray, perfectly spherical body without any visible internal hollows, external holes, or hanging loops in the current view.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric Christmas ornament ball in OpenSCAD with a customizable radius, wall thickness percentage, and adjustable hole patterns. The design should feature a hollow main sphere, a top cylindrical collar with a crossbar for hanging, and a configurable distribution of radial holes around the sphere.
captions.factory: The script constructs the ornament by first defining a main sphere of a given radius. A smaller concentric sphere is subtracted to hollow it out, alongside a series of cylindrical cuts rotated around the Z and Y axes in a nested loop to create a pattern of radial holes. A cylindrical hanging collar is added to the top of the sphere, which is hollowed out with a larger cylinder, and a thin cube is positioned across the top of this collar to serve as a hanging bar. The entire assembly is rotated 180 degrees for optimized 3D printing orientation.
